title: delegate_task timeout before API calls
summary: delegate_task can return status:timeout with api_calls:0 after exactly 300s; repeated delegation is usually wasteful, so work inline.

title: patch lint can falsely report Rust 2015 async errors
summary: Hermes patch() lint output can report Rust 2015 async errors even when the crate uses edition 2021; verify with cargo check before trusting it.

title: Joseph prefers foundation-first sequencing
summary: Joseph prefers fixing foundations before building new features on non-trivial projects.

title: GH200 has no installed llama-server systemd service
summary: The GH200 server had no installed llama-server.service; only a not-found stub and stray /tmp/llama-server.service were observed.
